processed.note: Edge-authed endpoints (quant/gex, quant/positioning, hyperliquid/*) now serve the same complete upgrade object + Retry-After on 403/429 that the app-authed endpoints already had (2026-08-28, 2026-09-03). Consistency fix at the edge layer, no new field shape, no wiki-visible surface -- same disposition as its two predecessor releases in this family.

why_subscribe field added to the upgrade object (403s + now 429s too). The parent upgrade object itself (introduced 2026-08-28) was already marked noted -- no wiki page documents the tier-403/429 upgrade-path shape in enough detail to need updating with this incremental field. Consistent with the 2026-08-28 disposition.

Onboarding/agent-UX polish (auth/keys next_calls ladder, GET /api/v1 first_calls, list_capabilities no-key, MCP tool error enrichment, urllib User-Agent gotcha). No wiki page walks the mint/verify/upgrade sequence step-by-step; x402 agent-subscribe already documented on cryptodataapi-mcp.md. No edit needed.

Bug fixes to limit (funding-rates) and minutes (liquidity/depth) params. Wiki's cryptodataapi-derivatives.md documents limit without claiming the old broken fixed-window behavior, and no wiki page describes liquidity/depth's minutes semantics in detail. No stale claims to correct.
